flipToBack.timing: Required after-trigger on the blown-away event (isBlownAwayLastStep), NOT isTableChanged.
flipToBack.prose: Flip when Main Power Generators is 'blown away' (last step of the blown-away process). Single event condition; no board-count threshold.

children.req: timing trigger: Main Power Generators blown away (last step)

flipToFront.timing: NEVER flips back. Back has a hard-lose instead: PLACED OUT OF PLAY on isTableChanged if the occupation condition fails.
flipToFront.prose: No FlipCardEffect on the back. Required after-trigger: on isTableChanged, if canBePlacedOutOfPlay and you can NOT spot a Hoth site that you occupy with (piloted AT-AT OR Imperial leader OR snowtrooper), the objective is placed out of play.

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: pure blown-away event on an exact-title location (Title.Main_Power_Generators, exact match true); the objective only listens. Rando's encoded pursuit route is specifically Target The Main Generator (V) 222_13, not classic 3_115

back hard-lose: OCCUPY-with semantics - need >=1 Hoth SITE occupied with piloted AT-AT (Filters.and(Filters.AT_AT, Filters.piloted)) or Imperial leader or snowtrooper; checked via canSpot on Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, ...)) with INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE
no flip-back exists: once flipped, the only failure mode is out-of-play loss of the objective
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.AT_AT, Filters.piloted), Filters.Imperial_leader, Filters.snowtrooper))) (hard-lose guard)

profileGaps: The profile encodes the exact 222_13 pursuit prerequisites, but the actual >8 epic-event result and isBlownAwayLastStep flip remain engine outcomes rather than board-state facts

The profile expresses the firing endpoint as the first 1st, 2nd, or 3rd Marker where the physical Cannon is actually in range, so 3rd is terminal without Light Side 2nd but remains a bridge when 2nd is inserted

The DTO evaluates Target 222_13 and the in-range cannon package as separate alternatives across the same 1st-through-3rd Marker union; runtime counting must require both alternatives at one physical location and fail closed otherwise

requiredCardsOnTable names Target The Main Generator and AT-AT Cannon so pull, Force reserve, deploy, and Force-loss policies preserve the executable package; runtime physical-card matching restricts the Target requirement to virtual 222_13 and excludes classic 3_115
The back is encoded as purpose stayFlipped with the exact durable occupier union. Failure places the objective out of play; it is not represented as flipBack
